newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany Sept inflation unchanged at 1.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: Germany Sept inflation unchanged at 1.4 percent.

text.p: German consumer price inflation was unchanged in September at an annual 1.4 percent, the Federal Statistics Office said Friday, confirming that price pressures remain subdued.
The pan-German consumer price index slipped by 0.1 percent month-on-month, also in line with the decline in August.

Inflation in the economically dominant west was exactly in line with the national figure, while in the former communist east, prices were down 0.2 percent against the previous month but up 1.6 percent on a year earlier.
The strongest price increase in the components of the CPI came in energy, which jumped 2 percent in September from August. Prices of personal equipment fell by 3.3 percent.
